name: qrdx-raycast
title: QRdx
description: Styled QR codes made on your Mac, plus the dynamic codes in your QRdx account: change where they point and see their scans.
author: ritesh_bucha

commands.name: generate-qr
commands.title: Generate QR
commands.subtitle: QRdx
commands.description: Generate a QR code with your choice of body pattern, corner style, colors, frame and logo.

commands.name: saved-qrs
commands.title: Saved QR Codes
commands.subtitle: QRdx
commands.description: Browse, preview, edit and export your saved QR code configurations.

commands.name: ai-generate
commands.title: Generate QR with AI
commands.subtitle: QRdx
commands.description: Describe the QR code you want and let Raycast AI configure it for you.

commands.name: dynamic-codes
commands.title: Dynamic QR Codes
commands.subtitle: QRdx
commands.description: Browse the dynamic codes in your QRdx account, see their scans, change where they point and export them.

commands.name: create-dynamic-code
commands.title: Create Dynamic QR Code
commands.subtitle: QRdx
commands.description: Create a dynamic code in your QRdx account: a short link you can point somewhere else later, with scan counts.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: QRdx API Key
preferences.description: Only for the dynamic-code commands and AI tools. Create a key in QRdx under Settings → API keys & apps; every plan has them.

tools.name: generate-qr
tools.title: Generate QR Code
tools.description: Generate a QR code PNG for any URL, text, email, or phone number with optional body pattern, corner style, colors, and a call-to-action frame with a label. Saves the PNG to ~/Downloads.

tools.name: list-saved
tools.title: List Saved QR Codes
tools.description: List all QR codes previously saved in the qrdx library. Optionally filter by name or URL.

tools.name: list-dynamic-codes
tools.title: List Dynamic QR Codes
tools.description: List the dynamic QR codes in the user's QRdx workspace with their ids, short links, destinations and scan counts. Optionally search them.

tools.name: create-dynamic-code
tools.title: Create Dynamic QR Code
tools.description: Create a dynamic QR code in the user's QRdx workspace: a short link that opens a web address, can be pointed elsewhere later and counts scans. Saves its PNG to ~/Downloads.

tools.name: update-destination
tools.title: Change Destination
tools.description: Change the web address a dynamic QR code in the user's QRdx workspace opens. The code and its short link stay the same.

tools.name: get-scans
tools.title: Get Scans
tools.description: Scan analytics of a dynamic QR code in the user's QRdx workspace: total and unique scans in a period, top countries, cities, devices, systems, browsers and referrers.

ai.instructions: When the user asks to generate, create, or make a QR code, use generate-qr, unless they ask for a dynamic, editable or trackable code, or one whose destination can change later: then use create-dynamic-code. When they ask about saved QR codes, use list-saved. For the dynamic codes in their QRdx account (scans, analytics, changing where a code points), find the code with list-dynamic-codes, then use get-scans or update-destination with its id. For body patterns, prefer 'rounded' or 'circle' for modern/minimal styles, 'square' for classic. For colors, convert descriptive names to hex. Always confirm the URL before generating.
